notes.title: Dev Log #26 - 1.0.4 Build Highlights and Patch Notes
notes.notes: 1.0.4 brings about new maps, updates to existing maps, new server admin features, and more. Check out the full list of updates on the blog.

notes.title: Dev Log #25 - Build Highlights, 1.0.2.9415 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The 1.0.2.9415 patch contains some content and Quality-of-Life updates. Dev Log #25 will explore these features, available for download now. As always, a big thank you to the community members who are actively working on releasing these great features for the community: PeTtY, Hobb, JEstEr, Implosions.

Read about it here!

notes.title: Dev Log #24 - New Community Development Effort, 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Our first build in a long while has been deployed! Check out the details about the content and bug fixes in 1.0.2 patch as well as information on the community effort behind it in Dev Log #24.

notes.title: Dev Log #23 – 1.0.1.9141 Patch Notes, Midair's Future
notes.notes: Build 1.0.1.9141 has been deployed and the client is now available for download on Steam. For all of the details on the new content including the Sticky Launcher, the new art on Brynhildr, performance improvements, and more including a note on the future of Midair, check out Dev Log #23.

notes.title: Dev Log #22 - Hotfix 1.0.1 Patch Notes and Looking Ahead
notes.notes: Hotfix 1.0.1 has been deployed to all servers and the client is now available for download. This should fix top user issues like unlocks not unlocking, skill points being consumed without getting the unlocks, the alt-tab hang, vote kicking, and more! For details on what's in this hotfix and to hear about what we're focusing on next, check out Dev Log #22.

notes.title: Release Trailer and Dev Log #21 - Build 0.32.0 Highlights, Patch Notes, and More!
notes.notes:
We're only a day away from launch and with that launch comes a new trailer! Check out our free-to-play launch trailer available now on YouTube and the Midair Steam Store page.

And just in case you missed it, check out Dev Log #21 with lots of great details about build 0.32.0 that went live earlier this week. In the dev log we show off new cosmetic options, loot chests, scoring system overhauls, the Steam Inventory Service, and plenty more!

notes.title: Midair Release Date Announced: May 3rd
notes.notes:
Midair has come a long way from its Kickstarter campaign, and in two weeks we’ll be releasing it to the world as a free-to-play title! Our official release date is:

May 3rd, 2018!

We’re hard at work adding as many features, quality of life improvements, and bug fixes as we can to get the game to its v1.0 state. 

Check out the full blog post here.

notes.title: Dev Log #20 - Build 0.31.0 Highlights, Patch Notes, and More!
notes.notes: Proxies, we are moving quickly toward our release target and with this major update comes a host of great content and improvements. The docket today includes the release of the WARDEN weapon, the first showing of the map Orbital, Team Deathmatch, armor and weapon skins, and plenty more! Check out Dev Log #20 here and download the update!

notes.title: Dev Log #19 – Build 0.30.0 Highlights, Patch Notes, and Release Update
notes.notes:
Build 0.30.0 is now LIVE. We've got v1 of our progression system, a beautiful new fully arted map CTF-Reservoir (previously CTF-Dam), CTF gameplay changes, a brand new main menu/loadout screen background, and release timing updates.

Read about all of these things and more in Dev Log #19.
